en.headline: Helicopter lifts woman after she vomits blood while hiking near Sai Kung Danjiawan
en.dek: A middle-aged woman in a group of 16 was airlifted conscious to Eastern Hospital after sudden cramps and vomiting blood on Saturday morning.
body: Police received a report at about 10:06am on Saturday that a middle-aged woman had suddenly vomited blood and suffered cramps while hiking near Danjiawan in Sai Kung.
The woman was part of a group of 16 who had set out from Wong Shek Pier. Companions called for help, and the Government Flying Service sent a helicopter to lift her out.
She remained conscious and was taken to Eastern Hospital for treatment. Police are investigating the incident.

zh.headline: 西貢蛋家灣中年婦行山突吐血抽筋 直升機救起送東區醫院
zh.dek: 16名女子今早由黃石碼頭出發，其中一名中年婦近蛋家灣時不適，清醒由政府飛行服務隊直升機送院。
body: 今日上午約10時06分，警方接報西貢蛋家灣附近有中年女子行山期間突然吐血及抽筋。
事主與另外15名女子由西貢黃石碼頭出發，同行者立即報案。政府飛行服務隊派出直升機將她救起。
事主保持清醒，送往東區醫院治理。警方正調查事件。
